1106 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
327 days before 11-25-1106:  
Back 25 days → 10-31-1106, then back 302 more days (31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31+30+?):  
From 10-31 back through months: Oct(31 days) → Sep 30 → Aug 31 → Jul 31 → Jun 30 → May 31 → Apr 30 → Mar 31 → Feb 28 → Jan 31.  
Count: 25 days (Oct) + 30+31+31+30+31+30+31+31+28+31 = 25 + 304 = 329 days back → overshoot by 2 days.  
So 327 days back = 329 days back + 2 days forward → 1106-01-01 + 2 days = 1106-01-03.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1106-01-03
